findings.title: plan.md category enum missing 'cosmetic' — scan files emit it but schema rejects it
findings.detail: plan.md line 84 defined the category enum as 'logic|assumption|overconfidence|risk|redo'. Production scan files (e.g. 2026-06-08 findings) emit category:'cosmetic'. The schema omission causes validator drift between what scans produce and what the spec allows. Fixed by appending '|cosmetic' to the enum string.
findings.fix_sketch: Add '|cosmetic' to the category enum value on line 84.

findings.title: plan.md schema example detail field says '2-3 paragraph description' but actual usage is 2-3 sentences
findings.detail: plan.md line 86 shows '"detail": "2-3 paragraph description"' in the canonical schema example. All production scan files contain single-paragraph detail strings of 2-3 sentences, not multi-paragraph blocks. Spec says 'paragraph' when it means 'sentence', creating ambiguity for implementers and future audit agents.
findings.fix_sketch: Change '2-3 paragraph description' to '2-3 sentence description' on line 86.

findings.title: README.md Phase 3 status still shows 'in progress' — soak ended 30 days ago
findings.detail: Phase 3 (2-week soak) started 2026-05-21 and the README status column still reads '🟡 in progress'. As of 2026-06-20 that is 30 days elapsed — 2 weeks past the soak target. The Phase 4 gate evaluation (fingerprint REGRESSION + DRAFT auto-rules) has not been formally decided, but the soak itself is complete. Status updated to reflect soak completion and flag the pending Phase 4 gate decision.
findings.fix_sketch: Update Phase 3 row status column to 'soak complete (30 days elapsed as of 2026-06-20) — Phase 4 gate evaluation pending'.

findings.title: docs/proposer-spec.md references phantom predecessor 'docs/elevation/upgrades/05-goal-driven.md'
findings.detail: proposer-spec.md line 5 Predecessors field lists 'docs/elevation/upgrades/05-goal-driven.md (if present)'. This path does not exist on disk and never has. The '(if present)' qualifier was a hedge that has now expired — the file was never created in the elevation push. Retaining a reference to a phantom file pollutes the dependency graph and confuses future readers who may waste time searching for it.
findings.fix_sketch: Remove 'docs/elevation/upgrades/05-goal-driven.md (if present)' from the Predecessors list on line 5.

findings.title: README.md spec docs table says proposer-spec has '8 sections' but it has 9
findings.detail: README.md spec docs table row for proposer-spec.md says '8 sections + 8 open decisions'. Counting the actual H2 sections in proposer-spec.md: 1.Purpose, 2.Inputs, 3.Scoring, 4.Proposal format, 5.Output channel, 6.Noise discipline, 7.Budget gate, 8.Failure modes, 9.Open decisions = 9 sections.
findings.fix_sketch: Change '8 sections' to '9 sections' in the proposer-spec.md row of the spec docs table.

findings.title: plan.md fingerprint description uses 'reopened' — non-canonical term, correct term is 'regression'
findings.detail: plan.md line 100 reads 'same bug reopened twice gets same fingerprint'. The canonical status lifecycle in this repo is 'open|fixing|verifying|fixed|closed|regression' — 'reopened' is not a valid status. The prose should use 'regression' to match the lifecycle spec and avoid confusion with git/issue tracker 'reopen' semantics.
findings.fix_sketch: Change 'reopened' to 'surfacing as a regression' in the fingerprint description prose.
